title: Trigonometric Equations and General Values
formulas: **Multiple & Submultiple Angles — the complete formula sheet for NEB.**
**Power & product rewiring — the bridge to submultiple angles**
$$\tan\frac{A}{2} = \pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos A}{1+\cos A}} = \frac{\sin A}{1+\cos A} = \frac{1-\cos A}{\sin A}$$
$$\cot\frac{A}{2} = \pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos A}{1-\cos A}} = \frac{\sin A}{1-\cos A} = \frac{1+\cos A}{\sin A}$$
**± rule:** in $\sin\frac A2$, $\cos\frac A2$ and $\tan\frac A2$ take $+$ or $-$ from the quadrant in which $\frac A2$ lies — $A/2$ is not automatically acute.
**Any angle $nA$ — de Moivre, the source of every formula above**
$$\left(\cos A + i\sin A\right)^n = \cos nA + i\sin nA$$

Expand the left side with the binomial theorem and match the real and imaginary parts: $\cos nA$ and $\sin nA$ fall out as polynomials in $\sin A$ and $\cos A$ — that is exactly how the 2A, 3A and 4A identities above are generated.
